description: A null element of a block array defines a block with an empty body
notes: The spec says the value that defines blocks is either a JSON object or a JSON array of objects, so a null element of the array isn't allowed. hashicorp/hcl makes a block of each element, and a null body has no properties when it is processed by schema ((*body).unpackBlock and (*body).collectDeepAttrs in json/structure.go).
